title: Time to goal decides the next step
objectives: Match each time-to-goal band to the right next step.
Explain why the job changes from growing to protecting.
body_md:
The right next step depends on one thing above all: how far away the goal is.

| Time to goal | Next step | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| 7+ years | Renew or extend the SIP; step up each year | SIP renewal, step-up (top-up) facility |
| 3–7 years | Keep the SIP; start planning the glide path | Annual review, asset-mix target |
| 1–3 years | Stop new equity money; shift gradually to debt | STP from equity to debt or liquid funds, new SIPs into debt |
| Under 1 year | Money mostly in liquid or short-duration debt | Redeem or switch the remainder on a plan |
| Goal reached | Pay for the goal, or set up regular income | Staged redemption, SWP |

## The change of job

For a long goal, the job is to grow the money and to keep buying through falls. As the goal approaches, the job becomes protecting what has been built, so a fall just before the goal cannot derail it. Same client, same SIP, different job.

The rest of this stage works through the rows one at a time.
example: A client's retirement is 20 years away, so the answer is renewal plus a yearly step-up. His daughter's fee, due in 18 months, is a separate pot that belongs in debt now.
say: With seven years or more to go, we renew and step up.
As the goal gets closer, our job changes from growing the money to protecting it.
never: Keep everything in equity; the goal is only two years away.
One switch today is the same as a glide path.

check.q: A client's goal is 8 years away and the SIP has just ended. What is the next step?
o: Renew or extend the SIP, and step up each year
check.why: With 7+ years to go, renew and step up. Staged redemption and SWP come much later.

check.q: A goal is 2 years away. What is the next step?
o: Stop new equity money and shift gradually to debt
Do nothing until the goal date
check.why: One to three years out: stop new equity money and shift gradually to debt, usually through an STP.

check.q: Money is needed in under a year. Where should it sit?
o: Mostly in liquid or short-duration debt funds
check.why: Under a year, the money should be mostly in liquid or short-duration debt.
